'''Noa Endac''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Noa Endac was the son of a military [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and was raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He later joined the Imperial Navy, becoming one of the bxiest [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxers]] in his class. During the Galactic Civil War, he was assigned serve aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] as part of the ship's security force, and following the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tanith Sorn]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Endac was part of a team chosen by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to investigate the crime.
